basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Mangalagiri, Andhra Pradesh has released an official advertisement (Advertisement – July 2026, F.No/AIIMS/MG/Reg/SR(NA)/2026-27/03 dated 22 July 2026) inviting applications for the posts of Senior Resident/Senior Demonstrator across 19 departments. A total of 36 posts are on offer. Eligible candidates can apply online through the Google Form link provided by the institute on or before 5 August 2026. There is no walk-in interview for this recruitment.

important_dates.raw: Notification Release Date: 22 July 2026 Closing Date for Online Application: 5 August 2026 Document Verification/Interview Schedule: Will be intimated later on the official website

application_fee.details: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through NEFT/UPI to the bank account below. Candidates applying for more than one department must pay the fee separately for each department.

age_limit.details: Upper Age Limit: 45 years (as on the closing date of application) Age Relaxation for SC/ST: up to 5 years Age Relaxation for OBC: up to 3 years Age Relaxation for PwBD candidates: 10 years (General category), 13 years (OBC category), 15 years (SC/ST category)

selection_process: Selection will be made purely on the basis of an interview. However
if the number of applied candidates is high
a screening test based on MCQs in the concerned subject will be conducted first
followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates. There is no provision for displaying marks or for re-checking/re-evaluation.
how_to_apply: Visit the official AIIMS Mangalagiri website or click the direct Google Form link provided in the advertisement.
Fill in the Google Form with accurate personal, educational, and category details.
Upload the scanned copy of the filled application form (Annexure-I) in the prescribed format.
Upload the necessary supporting documents and payment transaction details as required.
Pay the applicable application fee through NEFT/UPI to the account specified in the notification.
Submit the form before the closing date of 5 August 2026.
Keep a printout/copy of the filled application and Annexure-I & II, as these must be produced in hard copy at the time of document verification before the interview.
important_instructions: Age and qualifications/experience will be counted as on the closing date of application (crucial date). Only candidates who have cleared their qualifying degree examination and completed the tenure for the same on or before the crucial date will be eligible. Possessing the prescribed qualification does not automatically entitle a candidate to selection. Incomplete applications and canvassing of any kind will lead to rejection/disqualification. Private practice of any type is strictly prohibited during the tenure. Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/PSU must apply through proper channel and submit an original NOC at the time of interview; in-service candidates will not be permitted for the interview without an NOC. The appointment is governed by the Government of India's Residency Scheme and can be terminated by either side with one month's notice or one month's salary. The tenure is for a maximum of 3 years, renewed for periods of 12 months at a time, based on HOD recommendation and Competent Authority discretion. Selected candidates will be given 24 days to join the post, extendable by 7 days in exceptional circumstances with proper justification. No further extension is permitted. Appointees are not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion, or other regular Government employee benefits. Appointment is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by the competent Medical Board. No travelling or other allowances will be paid for attending the screening test/interview or for joining the post. All updates, corrigenda, and addenda will be published only on the official Institute website.

Applicants looking for opportunities closer to this region can also check the latest Andhra Pradesh Government Jobs and Guntur Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those interested in other AIIMS recruitment drives can explore more AIIMS Recruitment 2026 notifications from across the country.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must produce one set of self-attested photocopies of the following documents (along with originals for verification) at the time of interview/document verification: Duly filled and signed original Application Form (Annexure-I) Filled Proforma/Checklist (Annexure-II) Identity proof (preferably Aadhaar Card) Date of Birth certificate (10th certificate/Birth certificate) MBBS/M.Sc/BDS (UG) mark sheets and certificates MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch mark sheets and certificates Attempt certificate (for MBBS and postgraduation) FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign medical graduates) Registration with Medical Council of India/State Medical Council/Dental Council of India or State No Objection Certificate (NOC), in case of Government/Semi-Government/PSU employees Experience certificate, if applicable Reservation category certificate (EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwBD), if applicable Research publications, if any

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for submitting the online application is 5 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 36 vacancies for Senior Resident/Senior Demonstrator posts spread across 19 departments.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a walk-in interview for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: No. The notification clearly states there is no walk-in interview; candidates must apply online through the Google Form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the closing date of application, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: Medical candidates are paid as per 7th CPC Pay Level-11 with an entry pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus NPA and other allowances. Non-medical candidates (M.Sc with Ph.D) are paid Rs. 56,100/- under Level-10 plus other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1,500/- for General/EWS/OBC candidates and Rs. 1,000/- for SC/ST candidates. PwBD candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an interview only. If the number of applicants is high, a screening test based on MCQs will be held first, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview schedule for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 be released?
faq.answer: As per the notification, the document verification/interview schedule for all departments (S.No. 1 to 19) will be intimated later on the official website, www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in.
